extracted.name: Bacon-Wrapped Scallops
extracted.description: Bacon-wrapped scallops are a deliciously easy and elegant appetizer made with just three ingredients: sea scallops, bacon, and fresh lemon juice.
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Cut bacon slices in half and wrap each half around a scallop. Use a toothpick to secure in place. Drizzle lemon juice over scallops. Place on a cookie sheet.
Bake in a preheated oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until bacon is cooked. Serve warm.
